root_cause.text: The `scx_enable()` function performs its task-switching loop in the calling thread's context, which gets its sched_class changed from fair to ext; because the fair class has higher scheduling priority than ext, the calling thread can be indefinitely starved by saturating fair-class workloads, leading to a system hang.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "During scx_enable(), the READY -> ENABLED task switching loop changes the calling thread's sched_class from fair to ext. Since fair has higher priority than ext, saturating fair-class workloads can indefinitely starve the enable thread, hanging the system." The fix offloads the work to a dedicated RT (SCHED_FIFO) kthread to prevent starvation.
